evidence_resolution_note: Basenames refer to same-version frozen C14 copies. No historical B evidence inherited.

gates.scope: AA3 whole front/left/rear/top. Skeleton isolation is not whole appearance evidence.
gates.closure_condition: Remove identifiable outline/partition/occlusion differences in source-bound full renders; disclose any required major shape change before adoption.

gates.scope: 30 of 42 actual member sections under finite gravity/contact model; 12 unanalysed. Nominal margins meet internal target in sampled double-support cases.
gates.closure_condition: Verify continuous critical regions, actual material/geometry and joint/foot load paths; no whole-structure release from this beam subset.

gates.scope: Box bends, pedestal, branch junctions, annular stock ends; overlaps not assembly-trimmed.
gates.closure_condition: Actual connected CAD with flange/fastener/weld sizing, stiffness and strength under same joint wrenches; installation and maintenance evidence.

gates.scope: 8 sockets counted by conditional steel stock density only; machined stock has no assigned S355 strength.
gates.closure_condition: Material/shaft/bearing fit, load rating, shaft/seat/retention and local stress evidence; assign mass and motion ownership once topology is established.

gates.scope: Six foot-base beams have no verified reaction load-sharing/plate/connection analysis.
gates.closure_condition: Same native sole forces transferred through an actual toe/heel/plate/junction design with local stiffness, pressure and strength proof.

gates.scope: No beam stability, local plate buckling or fatigue allowance approved.
gates.closure_condition: Joint-boundary-dependent global/local stability plus weld/connection fatigue under selected duty cycle and load spectrum.

gates.scope: Untrimmed stock sum and explicit unselected-component reserves; full body inertia undefined.
gates.closure_condition: Trimmed non-overlapping assembly/component mass ledger, verified envelopes and complete positive-definite inertia per body, with drive/rotor ownership.

gates.scope: Original joint points preserved; complete installation and sweep clearances unverified.
gates.closure_condition: Native structure/armor/hardware/line-bundle clearances and actual self-collision sweeps over required poses; retain real contacts.

gates.scope: World six-dimensional joint wrenches are demands, not axis motor ratings.
gates.closure_condition: Resolve axes/order and support topology; match torque/speed/holding/braking/continuous heat duty and selected or credible custom drive ranges.

gates.scope: Ten double-support gravity cases feasible; neutral single-left empty/pressure cases infeasible. No motion or friction model.
gates.closure_condition: Real weight-transfer path and free-root limited-drive/self-collision rejection tests; native-engine contact without phantom support, followed by held-object tasks.

gates.scope: 2008 sampled intake armor-gap rays per side clear; no heat budget, full fluid/air route or electrical rating.
gates.closure_condition: Same-version heat sources, heat transfer/coolant/radiator/fan/sealed ducts and exhaust path; full voltage/current/regen/protection/duty validation.

gates.scope: Structural gravity entry exists; no complete stable dynamics/axes/limits/drive/sensor/timing contract.
gates.closure_condition: Body mass/full inertia, joints/order/axes/limits, drive capacities, collision, sensor/control timing bound to model/render/evidence; native Bevy interface and repeated task/failure-recovery tests.

gates.scope: Finite member dimensions and conditional stock mass established; custom bends/sockets/joins have no supplier-approved processing/material.
gates.closure_condition: Resolve exact material/process/component or credible custom capability range after physical red items close; procurement uncertainty cannot release structure.

gates.scope: Explicit sensitivity mass reserves only; actual size/output/thermal ranges not yet supplier-backed, so yellow is not admissible as physical clearance.
gates.closure_condition: Obtain credible dimensions/mass/output/thermal ranges and run physical verification across them, then resolve procurement/custom supply separately.
